about_the_game:
"My Waifu Becomes Real" is an immersive interactive visual novel that blurs the lines between fantasy and reality. Step into the life of an anime enthusiast whose dreams come true when Laras, his beloved waifu, becomes real and starts living with him.

Experience a story filled with humor, warmth, and heart-fluttering moments as you navigate the joys and challenges of living with a waifu who’s charming, quirky, and full of surprises.

Meet Laras

  • Sweet and Caring: Always ready to brighten your day with her infectious energy.

  • Playful and Quirky: Laras isn’t just cute—her antics will leave you laughing and wanting more.

  • Full of Surprises: From helping you with daily tasks to asking for your attention, she’s as real as it gets!

Game Features

First-Person Immersion
Experience the story through your character’s eyes and enjoy a lifelike perspective that puts you right in the action.

Branching Storylines
Your choices shape the narrative! Will you bond deeply with Laras, focus on your responsibilities, or explore the unexpected? Every decision unlocks unique interactions and endings.

Interactive Gameplay
Manage your daily life while Laras brings chaos and sweetness to your world. Explore the environment, engage in heartfelt dialogues, and discover hidden surprises.

High-Quality Visuals
Stunning visuals bring Laras to life, ensuring every moment feels vivid and engaging.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes romantic interactions between an employed man and his waifu, with some bedroom scenes that are not suitable for children. However, there is no nudity or sexual content—everything remains within tasteful and mature storytelling
